profile.headline: "Mobile coding was insane, total mutant speed."
profile.summary: Move fast but don't break things

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Android in the DMs

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description: Built the Quill Android app from scratch, by myself. Implemented business logic in a Kotlin Multiplatform library but not integrated on other platforms due to bugs/limitations in KMP. I did some backend (Golang) work too.  Quill was acquired by Twitter.

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description: Three month contract to help get Envoy Mobile released. Full-stack Android dev, coordinating with backend GraphQL engineers and iOS engineers. Added tests and mock mode where there were none before.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built mobile apps to help people book short term hotel/apartment stays (by the minute!).  I was the first engineering hire and took over ownership of the iOS app (in Swift) from the technical cofounder. I then built the Android app from scratch (in Kotlin).  I also worked on the APIs in our Go backend, using Google AppEngine + Cloud Datastore.  Super small engineering team (never more than three), so I jumped around pretty frequently.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I worked on the oven software, in particular:
- the setup flow
- exchanging wifi credentials using the Apple WAC protocol (I wrote some JNI/C code for this)
- widgets used across the rest of the oven UI

positions.title: Software Engineer/Manager
positions.description: I built the Android Caviar app by myself in three months.  I added more features, then began managing the server team while making gradual improvements to the Android app on the side.

positions.title: Android Engineer
positions.description: Worked on Square Order for Android: allowed you to place an order at a local business and come pick it up.

positions.title: Server Engineer
positions.description: Worked on Square Market, mostly on the Java backend service.  Built APIs for the web frontend to consume.  Remembered how databases work.  Also built backend APIs for Square Order.

positions.title: Android Engineer
positions.description: Lead engineer on the Square Wallet Android app (as it was renamed from Card Case -> Pay with Square -> Square Wallet).  Mostly coding but also responsible for triaging and prioritizing the bug/task queue, submitting apps, coordinating with other teams, etc.

positions.title: Senior Manager
positions.description: I ran our Android and Blackberry teams, working on Learn (academics) and Central (everything else).  I still wrote Android and other code (~40%) and did code reviews for everything, but focused more on coordination between QA/Support/Ops and growing our team.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
My engineering days spanned several positions in various departments at Blackboard, working on the core Blackboard Learn product as well as SaaS offerings like scholar.com and safeassign.com.

I joined our Mobile division to work on backend integration for Mobile Learn, and gradually transitioned to writing Android code and then leading our Java teams (Android, Blackberry)
